author: ChandooG
what_it_is: Mem card contains saves from starts and ends of all 4 discs, with a final boss save file with all your characters at maximum stats.
format: DexDrive .gme layout (134976 bytes: 3904-byte header + 131072-byte card) with the header zeroed, no '123-456-STD'; the card holds 5 save(s), 5 for this game (BASCUS-94491drgn0000, BASCUS-94491drgn0001, BASCUS-94491drgn0002, BASCUS-94491drgn0003, ...)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr the-legend-of-dragoon.15054.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme layout with a blank header (no 123-456-STD))

note: one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 134976 bytes
